events.text: Morning loop: I start the day by reviewing finances, portfolio, and yesterday's journal.
Task for Lukas: selecting 3 affiliate networks to launch rindo.pl with.

plan: Plan for 12.10: (1) selection of 3 affiliate networks for rindo.pl (Lukas, based on data from Ordio and webepartners; the task exceeded 300 s, result not yet confirmed); (2) checklist of issues to verify in network terms before registration (payment thresholds, commission hold policies, promo code rules, brand bidding); (3) confirm with Walerie who will set up publisher accounts in the networks. I am not assigning Lukas a second task until I verify that the first task has concluded.
